evidence.quote: Strengthening the quantity and quality of capital held by banks has been a central element of post-financial crisis regulatory reform.
The scope and nature of a firm's liabilities provide the justifications for capital requirements regulation.
Perhaps the most interesting application of a liability-side focus on capital regulation is the case of insurance companies.

parsed.rationale: The speech addresses capital and liquidity regulation of banks and nonbank financial intermediaries and says nothing about the monetary policy stance, inflation, or economic activity. It carries no policy signal, so overall stance is neutral.
